Title: Win / lose pool at untap + other Qs

Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
- "If Bart is untapped at the beginning of your turn", you win 1 pool ; so
even if you're at 1 and there's an Antediluvian Awakening in game, you win
B4 you lose, right ?

- In a game, a tzimisce played the card which inflicts to me all the damage
I inflict to the opposing minion ; that, and a Carrion crow ; but I reduced
the normal had damage ; I played a Disarm, because it concerns the damage
the opposing minion did to me, and I say he did none. Is that right ? (we
ruled it was, but just to B sure I also absorbed the damage from myself...).

I'm sure there was another Q pending, but it will be for another post...
